title: Simple NFT
tagline: Easily build NFT collections, for community leaders and builders
description: SimpleNFT is a platform for social tokens. Community leaders can launch their own NFT minting store front and get an easily shareable website. This website can be used by community members to mint their NFT. In the future, we want to implement a minting lottery to make minting more fair and to add more community management features.
how_its_made: Minting is done using NFTPort simple minting API. The backend is a TypeScript/JS Express server. The server renders a website with Vue JS components and Bulma CSS styling. A non-functional demo is hosted on netlify server -- it is not configured to run the API so the website must be ran locally for now.
